expectations.text: On WRITE, bit 7 is the set/clear control: if bit 7 = 1 the 1-bits set (enable) those mask bits; if bit 7 = 0 the 1-bits clear (disable) them
expectations.evidence: 'Bit 7 = set/clear select... Bit 7 = 1 → enables that source. Bit 7 = 0 → disables that source.'

expectations.text: On READ, the register returns the current interrupt flags
expectations.evidence: 'READ side = flags (INT DATA)... Returns which sources fired'

expectations.text: Reading the ICR CLEARS the interrupt flags (and acknowledges/de-asserts the interrupt)
expectations.evidence: 'Read clears all flags and releases the /IRQ line.'

expectations.text: Bit 7 on READ indicates whether an interrupt occurred (IR flag)
expectations.evidence: 'Bit 7 (IR)=1 means this chip raised the IRQ.'
